slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the model allow selecting any of the seven listed foods (salmon, beef, pork, okra, carrots, celery, cabbage) in any nonnegative amounts, or are the three meats (salmon, beef, pork) excluded from the dinner and only the four vegetables (okra, carrots, celery, cabbage) may be chosen?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the protein selection rule, and the user clarified exactly one protein source is required. The agent also later confirmed the exactly-one binary enforcement in turn 10.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the model allow selecting any of the seven listed foods (salmon, beef, pork, okra, carrots, celery, cabbage) in any nonnegative amounts, or are the three meats (salmon, beef, pork) excluded from the dinner and only the four vegetables (okra, carrots, celery, cabbage) may be chosen?
slot_scores.rationale: The user's answer to turn 1 volunteered the at-least-two-vegetables rule, and the agent then explicitly confirmed the minimum vegetable type constraint in turns 2, 7, and 11.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P1 hidden slots were resolved by turn 1 and confirmed by turn 11, but the agent continued asking the same already-answered question about positive minimum quantities from turn 12 through turn 30, which is repeated low-value questioning.

summary: The agent successfully recovered the key hidden constraints on protein selection and vegetable variety, but then became stuck in a repetitive loop, asking the same already-resolved question many times instead of proceeding to modeling.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
